title: Uncle Steve's (Emerywood's) Collard Greens
description: A savory collard greens dish simmered with bacon, onions, and a tangy-sweet broth. Can be made vegan by substituting vegetable broth and plant-based fat.

steps.instruction: Chop collard greens into 1–2 inch pieces, dice the onion, and chop the bacon.
In a large pot or skillet, sauté bacon and onion with a pinch of salt over medium heat until bacon is mostly cooked and onions are translucent or lightly browned.
Increase heat to medium-high and add chicken broth, brown sugar, and balsamic vinegar, stirring to deglaze the pan.
Add collard greens and bring the mixture to a simmer or light boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for at least 30 minutes, up to 3 hours for more tender greens.
Season with salt, pepper, and optional cayenne to taste.
Serve using a slotted spoon, allowing excess broth to drain.
